task.description:
Rework 1 — Fix CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR gaps in the OBP-01/02/03 + DDL-03 design artefacts.

Fix these issues in the design files:

**BLOCKER — migration number collision:**
- In templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml, change migration_number from 1165 to a number that does not collide with existing migrations. Check the migrations/ directory for the highest existing migration number and use max+1.

**MAJOR E050 — code blocks > 40 lines:**
- src/design/obp-01-outbox-depth-cap.md line 71: shorten the fenced code block to ≤40 lines (extract to a summary comment or split into multiple shorter blocks)
- src/design/obp-02-ingress-refusal.md line 70: same fix
- src/design/ddl-03-phased-ddl-generation.md line 75: same fix

**MAJOR Y132 — migration YAML test_cases missing required fields:**
- In templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml, add `requirement_ref`, `act`, and `assertions` to all test_cases entries

**MINOR OQ-unresolved — formally resolve or declare out-of-scope:**
- In each affected design file, add a 'Resolved Open Questions' section that either:
  a) Formally resolves each question with a concrete answer, or
  b) Explicitly declares it out-of-scope for this batch with rationale
- The three questions to resolve: (1) plat_outbox vs effects_outbox naming convention, (2) tenant extraction mechanism for the middleware, (3) identifier allow-list for OBP-02 event

After fixing, verify:
- No code block in any design file is >40 lines
- migration_number in migration YAML does not collide with any existing migration file
- All test_cases in migration YAML have requirement_ref, act, assertions
- All open questions are formally resolved or declared out-of-scope

Update all affected files on branch feature/WF02-obp-ddl-20260817.

validator_failures.MAJOR_Y132: migration YAML test_cases missing requirement_ref, act, assertions
validator_failures.MINOR_OQ: plat_outbox naming, tenant extraction, identifier allow-list not formally resolved

result.summary: Rework 1 complete — all 4 validator failures resolved: Y111 migration_number changed 1165→1167 (max existing 1166+1); E050 three code blocks split to ≤40 lines (obp-01 split into 2, obp-02 split into 2, ddl-03 split into 3); Y132 all 4 test_cases entries updated with requirement_ref+act+assertions; OQ all three open questions formally resolved or declared out-of-scope in their respective design files.
